mapper.insert: insert into nc_record_lock (baby_id, module_code, record_id, locker_user_id, locker_name, expire_time, heartbeat_time) values (#{babyId}, #{moduleCode}, #{recordId}, #{lockerUserId}, #{lockerName}, #{expireTime}, current_timestamp)
mapper.delete: delete from nc_record_lock where expire_time < current_timestamp
